Text: Everything you need to know about the $150M NextEra Energy ($NEE) Settlement Payout Q: What happened? A: The lawsuit alleges that Florida Power & Light (FPL), a subsidiary of NextEra Energy, used political consulting firm Matrix to secretly influence Florida politics through ghost candidates, covert campaign spending, and attacks on critics. Investors claim NextEra misled the market by denying involvement and failing to disclose the potential legal and reputational risks. After the allegations resurfaced in January 2023, $NEE fell 8.7%. NextEra agreed to a $150 million settlement. Q: Am I actually eligible? A: If you bought $NEE shares between 2021 and 2023, you’re likely eligible. You don’t need to still hold the stock to claim; past losses count Q: When do payouts happen? A: Typically, within 4–9 months after the claim deadline. But the exact timing depends on the court and settlement administration. Check if you're eligible and file a claim: https://11th.com/cases/nextera-investor-settlement
